title: How to display zero as a dash
task: Show "-" instead of 0 in reports, accounting-style, without destroying the numbers.

excel.note: This is a custom NUMBER FORMAT (Ctrl+1 → Custom), not a formula — the cell still contains the real 0.

google_sheets.note: Format → Number → Custom number format. Identical syntax.

libreoffice.note: Format → Cells → Number → Format code. Identical.

explanation: Number formats have up to three value sections separated by semicolons — positive;negative;zero — so putting "-" in the third slot swaps every zero's DISPLAY for a dash while the cell keeps its true value for sums and charts (the verification proves the format string via TEXT). This beats formula tricks like IF(A2=0,"-",A2), which turn numbers into text and quietly break downstream math. The built-in Accounting format uses exactly this mechanism.
